rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Raw {
    meta:
        description = "Detects raw Cobalt Strike beacon binaries via configuration artifacts"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://github.com/BC-SECURITY/Malleable-C2-Profiles"
        tlp = "amber"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike_beacon"
        malpedia_version = "20240610"
        malpedia_license = "Creative Commons CC-by-SA 4.0"
    strings:
        $a = { 6A 00 68 [2] 00 00 68 [2] 00 00 6A 00 FF D6 } // VirtualAlloc call pattern
        $b = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT" wide ascii
        $c = "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" wide ascii
        $d = "X-Metadata" wide ascii  // C2 header
    condition:
        all of them
}
